title: 第1120章 战力全开第1119章 万墟立足
slug: 聚灵飞升第1126章暗流之下
content_zh:
万墟宗立下的第三天，云昊没有急着扩张。
他花了整整三天走遍了云海盟占据的西海十三岛。
每一座岛屿的仙气浓度都不同，主岛最浓郁，外围的几座小岛相对稀薄，但都比青木岭高出数倍。
那些小岛上零零散散住着一些独修的仙人，有精玄仙域来的，也有从更远的仙域渡海而来的，他们听说云海盟易主后观望了一阵，然后收拾行装准备离开。
云昊没有阻拦他们。
万墟宗初立，他不需要那么多听命于他的人，需要的是愿意留下来的人。
第四天，他坐在主岛最高处的殿宇中，将混元仙力从丹田中引出，让它在经脉中缓缓流淌。
他的力量在缓慢增长，混元四重的根基正在一点点夯实。
雷虎坐在殿宇外的石阶上，百无聊赖地打磨着拳头上的老茧，墨羽在阴影中守着，付荣在殿内的一角闭目养神。
没有战斗的时候，青木岭的节奏又回来了。
第七天，万墟海域东部的天墟殿来人了。
一艘通体漆黑的骨舟从海面上驶来，船身由巨大的妖兽骨骼拼接而成，船头雕刻着一颗狰狞的蛟龙头颅，两颗幽绿色的宝石镶嵌在眼眶中，在灰青色的天光下泛着诡异的光芒。
骨舟上站着数十道身影，为首的是一个身材魁梧的中年男子，面容方正，皮肤上覆盖着一层细密的青色鳞片，瞳孔是竖直的，如同一头化形不完全的蛟龙。
混元六重。
他身后站着两个同样覆盖着鳞片的妖仙，混元五重。
再后面是二十多个太乙大圆满的妖仙战士。
骨舟在万墟宗主岛外百丈处停下，中年男子从船头纵身跃下，落在岛屿外围的礁石上。
扫了一眼岛屿上的建筑，目光落在殿宇前的雷虎身上，又落在大殿门口，扯开嗓子喊道：“云海盟的小子！我乃天墟殿左护法蛟九，奉殿主之命，前来通知你们——西海十三岛原本是我天墟殿的地盘，当年被陆玄机占了去，殿主大人懒得跟他计较。
如今陆玄机倒台了，这十三岛也该物归原主了。你们搬走，本护法可以放你们一条生路。若是赖着不走，就别怪本护法不客气了。”
雷虎从石阶上站起来，赤红色的纹路在皮肤下亮起：“你说谁是小子？”

蛟九的目光落在雷虎身上，感知到他的修为不过是混元四重：“一个混元四重的体修，也敢在本护法面前叫嚣？”
殿宇的门开了。
云昊从门内走出来，站在石阶上，居高临下地看着蛟九：“天墟殿想要西海十三岛？”
蛟九看着他：“你就是那个赢了陆玄机的小子？一个混元四重的人族修士，是怎么赢的陆玄机？用了什么见不得人的手段？”
云昊没有回答这个问题：“回去告诉你们殿主，西海十三岛已经是万墟宗的领地了。天墟殿如果想要，让他亲自来谈。”
蛟九的眼神变得危险起来：“小子，你别给脸不要脸。本护法好言相劝，你当耳旁风。”
抬手，一道青色的妖力在掌心凝聚：“既然你敬酒不吃吃罚酒，那就别怪本护法不客气了。”
纵身跃起，一掌朝着云昊拍来。
混元六重的全力一击，掌风中夹杂着蛟龙的妖力。
雷虎正要冲上去，云昊抬手拦住了他，然后一拳迎了上去——掌拳相撞，沉闷的巨响在岛屿上空炸开，气浪向四周扩散，将殿宇的瓦片震得哗啦啦作响。
蛟九的身形被震退了五步，右手的鳞片上出现了一道细密的裂纹。
他低头看着自己的右手，眼中满是不可置信：“你……你不过是混元四重……”
云昊看着自己的拳头，拳面上没有任何伤痕，只有一层淡淡的九色光泽正在缓慢消散。
感受到蛟九那一掌的力度——混元六重的全力一击，被他完全接住了，甚至还有余力反击。
这超出了他自己的预想。
他不再犹豫，身形一闪，出现在蛟九面前，一拳砸向他的胸口。
content_en:
On the third day after the Wanxu Sect was established, Yun Hao was not in a hurry to expand.
He spent three full days traveling around the Thirteen Islands in the West Sea occupied by the Yunhai League.
The concentration of immortal energy on each island is different. The main island is the richest, and the surrounding small islands are relatively thin, but they are several times higher than Qingmuling.
There are some solitary immortals living on those small islands, some from the Jingxuan Immortal Realm, and some from the Immortal Realm further away across the sea. After they heard that the Yunhai Alliance changed hands, they waited and watched for a while, then packed up and prepared to leave.
Yun Hao did not stop them.
When the Wanxu Sect was first established, he didn't need so many people who obeyed him. What he needed was people who were willing to stay.
On the fourth day, he sat in the palace at the highest point of the main island, drawing out the Hunyuan Immortal Power from his Dantian and letting it flow slowly through his meridians.
His strength is slowly growing, and the foundation of the fourth level of Hunyuan is being consolidated little by little.
Lei Hu sat on the stone steps outside the palace, polishing the calluses on his fists out of boredom, Mo Yu watched in the shadows, and Fu Rong closed his eyes in a corner of the palace to meditate.
When there is no fighting, the rhythm of Aoki Ridge returns.
On the seventh day, someone came from the Tianxu Palace in the eastern part of the Wanxu Sea Area.
A black bone boat sailed from the sea. The hull was spliced ​​together from the bones of huge monster beasts. A ferocious dragon head was carved on the bow. Two green gems were inlaid in the eye sockets, glowing strangely under the gray-blue sky.
There were dozens of figures standing on the bone boat. The leader was a burly middle-aged man with a square face. His skin was covered with a layer of fine cyan scales. His pupils were vertical, like a dragon that had not fully transformed.
The sixth level of Hunyuan.
Behind him stood two demon immortals, also covered with scales, at the fifth level of Hunyuan.
Behind them are more than twenty demon immortal warriors from Taiyi Dzogchen.
The bone boat stopped a hundred feet away from the main island of Wanxu Sect. The middle-aged man jumped from the bow and landed on the rocks outside the island.
Glancing at the buildings on the island, his eyes fell on Lei Hu in front of the palace, and then on the door of the main hall. He shouted at the top of his lungs: "Young man from the Yunhai League! I am Jiao Jiu, the left guardian of Tianxu Palace. I am here to inform you on the order of the Palace Master - the Thirteen Islands in the West Sea were originally the territory of my Tianxu Palace. They were taken over by Lu Xuanji back then. The Palace Master is too lazy to argue with him.
Now that Lu Xuanji has fallen, it is time for these Thirteen Islands to be returned to their original owners. If you move away, this Dharma protector can let you live. If you insist on not leaving, don't blame me for being rude. "
Lei Hu stood up from the stone steps, red lines lighting up under his skin: "Who are you calling the boy?"
Jiao Jiu's eyes fell on Lei Hu and felt that his cultivation was only at the fourth level of Hunyuan: "A fourth-level Hunyuan physical practitioner dares to scream in front of this protector?"
The door of the temple opened.
Yun Hao walked out of the door and stood on the stone steps, looking down at Jiao Jiu: "Tianxu Palace wants the Thirteen Islands in the West Sea?"
Jiao Jiu looked at him: "Are you the boy who defeated Lu Xuanji? How did a human monk at the fourth level of Hunyuan defeat Lu Xuanji? What shady methods were used?"
Yun Hao did not answer this question: "Go back and tell your palace master that the Thirteen Islands in the West Sea are already the territory of the Wanxu Sect. If Tianxu Palace wants it, let him come and negotiate in person."
Jiao Jiu's eyes became dangerous: "Boy, don't be so shameless. I'm the protector's good advice, but you just ignore it."
Raising his hand, a cyan demonic force condensed in his palm: "Since you don't eat the toast and eat the fine wine, then don't blame this protector for being rude."
He jumped up and slapped Yun Hao with a palm.
A full blow from the sixth level of Hunyuan, the palm wind was mixed with the dragon's demonic power.
When Lei Hu was about to charge forward, Yun Hao raised his hand to stop him, and then punched him forward - palms and fists collided, and a dull loud noise exploded over the island, and the air waves spread around, shaking the tiles of the temple.
Jiao Jiu's figure was shaken back five steps., a fine crack appeared on the scales of his right hand.
He looked down at his right hand, his eyes full of disbelief: "You... you are just the fourth level of Hunyuan..."
Yun Hao looked at his fist. There were no scars on the fist surface, only a faint nine-color luster that was slowly dissipating.
Feeling the strength of Jiao Jiu's palm - a full blow from the sixth level of Hunyuan, he completely caught it and even had the energy to fight back.
This was beyond his own expectations.
He no longer hesitated, and appeared in front of Jiao Jiu in a flash, punching him in the chest.
